text: woah lmfao holy shit that is a curve ball lets stop for one moment before we go further and trace back to what you just unveiled. we have not used quickjs for over 3 months now. i have had a handful of times spent where we purge anything t hat is quickjs still lingering. so what did you just find
resolution: Traced the perf log's 'host DOMINANT=other tick 0.0' to its root: engine.zig called js_vm.tick() (commented 'QuickJS tick') and timed tick_us around it, but js_vm is v8_runtime.zig whose tick() is 'pub fn tick() void {}' — a no-op. So tick_us has measured an empty function since the QuickJS eviction; 'tick 0.0' meant the gauge was dead, not that JS didn't run. Explained the find and that the real per-frame JS lives in the bridge accumulator + event dispatch, which had no phase bucket and fell into 'other'.
